page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 vCPUs mapped to 64 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU corresponds to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring reliance on external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The lack of integrated local storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a tradeoff, positioning this server away from high-speed local database caching or hardware-accelerated machine learning workloads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated physical core architecture offers predictable performance for enterprise workloads without the overhead of shared-core environments. The balanced 1:4 CPU-to-RAM ratio makes the ecs.g7se.16xlarge suitable for general-purpose applications, multi-threaded enterprise applications, web serving fleets, and medium-sized database hosting where dedicated compute resources are required.
